newsitem.title: ALBANIA: UK diplomat flown to Italy after Albania knifing.
newsitem.headline: UK diplomat flown to Italy after Albania knifing.

text.p: A British diplomat was stabbed in the Albanian capital on Monday and flown to Italy for an emergency operation, but the embassy here said the incident was not connected with crime or the current insecurity in Albania.
A spokesman at a hospital in the southern Italian city of Brindisi said the diplomat, whom he named as Jeff Briggs, was in a stable condition after surgery on his abdomen.
Embassy officials in Albania and Italy said the life of Briggs, the deputy head of mission, was not in danger.
"This has nothing to do with crime, or the security situation," the British embassy spokesman in Tirana told Reuters. Briggs was flown to Italy by military helicopter.
